modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: And here is yet another Kling 4.0 video. I can’t help myself, I just love it 😁 You can find the prompt below 😉 https://t.co/duEUAPujyp

originalPrompt: A colorful alien settlement filled with enormous spherical buildings and bizarre organic machines comes alive at sunrise, round red mechanical houses rotate their giant lens-like windows, pipes expand and contract like breathing organs, small robotic creatures run through shallow water, flying vehicles weave between towers, camera glides smoothly through the town at ground level before rising above the rooftops, puddles reflecting neon lights and clouds, natural vegetation moving in the wind, playful but believable extraterrestrial world, cinematic photorealism.
